description:
Presenting the video song "Kyo Kisi Ko" from the Bollywood movie "Tere Naam". This track is sung by Udit Narayan, music by Himesh Reshammiya & Lyrics are penned by Sameer. This movie is a romantic action drama film directed by Satish Kaushik. Written by Bala and Jainendra Jain, the film stars Salman Khan and Bhumika Chawla in her Bollywood film debut. Enjoy & Stay connected.
